The insulin B chain segment 13–20, protected by the benzyl group, has been synthesized stepwise in solution using the Boc-protected amino acids.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and characterization of the B 13–21 segment of insulin.
the synthesis and the conformational studies of a partial sequence of insulin B chain.
the synthesis of insulin and its fragments, the elucidation of the structure of insulin, and the elucidation of structure-activity relationships in insulin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the C-terminal region of insulin is a well-defined amphipathic alpha-helix with the hydrophobic face on the outside of the helix.
the Cys-13-Cys-16 disulfide bond is essential for the formation of the insulin hexapeptide helix.
the 3D-structure of the B 13–30 peptide segment is a mixture of α-helix and β-sheet.
